test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing the resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts) and the live-python suite now lives ONLY on the `e2e` target below.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. Deliberately NOT part of `affected` and NOT referenced by any target's dependsOn or by targetDefaults — it runs ONLY on an explicit `nx run apigen-plugin-py-flask:e2e` (nx affected never selects it). It runs the sibling plugin.e2e.ts suite via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn` is `^build` — the same upstream-build prerequisite the default `test` lane inherited from targetDefaults, which builds apigen-python-env (the managed interpreter the suite provisions + spawns at runtime). The suite never loads a built artifact of this package itself.
